description: Combine up to 10 quotes (quote_ids from get_print_quote) into one order: one start fee, one shipping package and the minimum price applied to the whole order. Use it when a model comes in several files (e.g. a zip with several parts). Returns cart_id, the combined price (pris.totalt, with pris.spart saved compared with ordering each part alone) and bestill_url. Order with create_order using cart_id, or give the user bestill_url. A new call with other quote_ids makes a new cart.

quote_ids.description: tilbud_id from get_print_quote, one per part.
